name: mhealth
paper_title: Design, implementation and validation of a novel open framework for agile development of mobile health applications
authors: Oresti Banos, Claudia Villalonga, Rafael Garcia, Alejandro Saez, Miguel Damas, Juan A. Holgado-Terriza, Sungyong Lee, Hector Pomares, Ignacio Rojas
venue: BioMedical Engineering OnLine, 14(Suppl 2):S6 (companion framework paper: Banos et al., IWAAL 2014, LNCS 8868, pp. 91-98)
license: CC BY 4.0 (dataset, UCI); journal paper open access under CC BY 4.0
notes: MHEALTH (Mobile Health) human activity recognition dataset. 10 subjects perform 12 physical activities: standing still, sitting & relaxing, lying down, walking, climbing stairs, waist bends forward, frontal arm elevation, knee bending (crouching), cycling, jogging, running, jumping front & back. 3 Shimmer2 wearable sensors on chest, right wrist, and left ankle. Signals: 3-axis acceleration (all 3 sensors), 2-lead ECG (chest only), 3-axis gyroscope and 3-axis magnetometer (wrist and ankle). Sampling rate: 50 Hz for all sensors. Data recorded in an out-of-lab environment with no constraints. 23 columns per subject file (acc/ECG/gyro/mag + activity label; label 0 = null/unlabeled). Provided as mHealth_subject<N>.log text files, one per subject. IMPORTANT for citation: UCI requests citing BOTH the framework papers -- the 2014 IWAAL conference paper (mHealthDroid framework, LNCS 8868 pp.91-98, DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-13105-4_14) AND the 2015 extended BioMedical Engineering OnLine journal paper (DOI 10.1186/1475-925X-14-S2-S6), which is the open-access PDF downloaded here (paper.pdf). Note the 2015 journal version was presented under the IWBBIO 2014 supplement banner. Dataset itself has UCI DOI 10.24432/C5TW22. Downloaded PDF verified as the 2015 BMC paper (title/authors match page 1). Author self-hosted PDF of the 2014 IWAAL paper: https://orestibanos.com/paper_files/banos_iwaal_2014.pdf
